# Features
extra short prints for WATCH mode
hide tests when
  some test fails
  some test is tagged #now
highlight

  tags (yellow)
errors

one line, compact summary
code logs

do not print test tree, just path
  print friendly when parallel tests
  
  one / two / my test 1
